description: Find endpoints by subject and get, for each, the method, the URL, the credit cost, the required body fields and a link to its reference page. Covers all 770 operations. No API key needed, so you can price a workflow before you have one.

keyless_only.description: Only endpoints that answer without a key. Default false.

limit.description: How many endpoints to return, 1 to 25. Default 8.

query.description: Subject or path fragment, e.g. "natal chart", "bazi", "solar return", "/transits".

name: find_endpoint
title: Find an Endpoint
